gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the Godox V1's guide number in its own manual is 42 m at ISO 100, with a head that only zooms to 105 mm. Shop tables list it as '92' or '76' next to the TT685 II's '60' without units or zoom settings, and '76' is the V1's flash energy in watt-seconds (76 Ws), not a guide number.
standout_why: I checked the cited B&H AK-R11 specs page (it returns 403 to my fetcher, so I could not read it) and the top diffuser roundup, cameraegg.org 'Best Diffuser for Godox V1 Flash' (2026-10-09). The cameraegg page gives only diffuser sizes, weights and prices. It says it prints no light-loss figure, and it has no guide number, zoom or flash energy figure. ChatGPT's answer names the V1 with an AK-R11 but gives no output figure, so nothing it got lets a shopper compare the V1 with a square-head speedlight on power.
decides: This supports the V1 + AK-R11 pick for diffused, bounced or close-range light: the V1 makes 76 Ws, recycles in about 1.5 s and gives about 480 full-power flashes from its Li-ion pack. It does not support picking it over a 20–200 mm square speedlight because of a bigger 'GN 92'. That figure has no stated conditions, and the V1's own manual says GN 42 m (ISO 100). For long-range direct flash, a 200 mm zoom head is the comparison to make, and I could not put both flashes at the same zoom setting from an opened page.
